question.text: Annual systems audit at a QRTA must be conducted by a professional holding which certification(s)?

answer.text: CA (Chartered Accountant) with DISA qualification only
Any IT professional with 5 years of experience
An independent CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) or CISM (Certified Information Security Manager) qualified or equivalent auditor

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.78, the QRTA must arrange an annual systems audit by an independent CISA/CISM-qualified or equivalent auditor. The independence requirement and the "or equivalent" allowance are both part of the source wording. The Trap: While CAs can audit financial statements, systems audits require specialized IT audit certifications (CISA, CISM, or equivalent). The two are distinct audit domains, and SEBI does not restrict the work to a single empanelled list here. Note: Treat the systems audit requirement as a QRTA obligation under CSCRF, and remember the auditor can hold CISA, CISM, or an equivalent credential.
